name: job-apply-kit
description: Claude Code / OpenCode skill kit for tailored resumes/CVs and staged (never auto-submitted) job applications

paragraphs: This is not a ready-to-use product, and it does not fit everyone. It is a set of scripts and instructions that help me find jobs and apply automatically. Expect to use it first, then keep giving your agent instructions as you go, so it adapts to your own workflow and your preferred job platforms. Treat it as a starting point you shape, not something you install and forget. Workshop guide and slides:

A Claude Code / OpenCode skill kit for tailoring resumes and CVs, and for automating the job-search and application grind: scanning BDJobs, LinkedIn, Facebook, Discord and pasted job-post screenshots, then staging an application for your review — never submitting or sending anything without you.
attach it as-is, or build one with /create-template from your own CV. Fast, consistent, truthful.
features: Template-first (the default): pick the closest-fit template from your own templatesdir and
